long_description:
AARI RCM is the revenue cycle management service offering from AARI, designed specifically for behavioral health practices. The service handles the complete billing lifecycle including insurance eligibility verification, claims submission, payment posting, denial management, and patient collections.

As a behavioral health-focused RCM service, AARI RCM understands the unique billing challenges of mental health practices including therapy session coding, psychiatric evaluation billing, and the complexities of mental health insurance coverage and prior authorizations.

The service integrates with AARI's EHR platform for seamless charge capture and claims generation. Practices using AARI's full suite benefit from unified clinical and billing workflows, though the RCM services may also be available to practices using other EHR systems.

AARI RCM serves behavioral health practices seeking to outsource billing operations to specialists who understand mental health reimbursement. This allows clinicians to focus on patient care while dedicated billing professionals handle revenue cycle tasks.
best_for: Behavioral health practices outsourcing billing operations
Mental health clinicians wanting billing specialists
AARI EHR users seeking integrated RCM services
Practices struggling with mental health claims denials
not_for: General medical practices without behavioral health focus
